plugins.name: Environmental Data
plugins.description: Environmental Data：跨已发布数据库检索与匹配环境过程数据，保留来源、版本、系统模型、单位及适用性证据；可访问数据取决于来源和账户权益。
plugins.description_en: Environmental Data: search and match environmental process data across published database sources, preserving source, version, system model, units and applicability evidence. Access depends on source and account entitlements.
plugins.author: HiQ
plugins.requirements: 原生 CLI 0.5.1，五平台自包含二进制，无需额外运行环境；只从自有 CDN 取得带 manifest 的原生归档。使用 querying-lca-datasets 自身登录或受控的 QUERYING_LCA_DATASETS_API_KEY，不注入 Desktop JWT，不读取旧客户端登录存储。安装不授予商业数值访问权益。本插件只读检索、匹配、查询与核验，不导入、绑定、计算、审核或通知。Chat 独立 querying-lca-datasets 技能原样保留；本插件使用不同的 expert/guide ID，不能据此声称 Desktop 旧 catalog 下载已退役。
plugins.requirements_en: Native CLI 0.5.1, five self-contained platform binaries with no external runtime, supplied only from the owned CDN in manifest-bearing archives. Uses its own login or a controlled QUERYING_LCA_DATASETS_API_KEY, never Desktop JWT or an old client login store. Installation grants no commercial numerical-data rights. Read-only search, inventory matching, lookup and verification: no import, binding, calculation, audit or notifications. The standalone Chat querying-lca-datasets skill is unchanged; distinct expert/guide IDs coexist without claiming Desktop legacy catalog retirement.

skills.description: 指导 Agent 使用真实 CLI 命令、自主鉴权及证据回执，检索并匹配过程数据集；按任务选择预设查找、清单匹配与代表性复核角色，不自动组成工作流。

agents.description: 过程数据集查找：按功能、来源坐标、参考产品/单位、地域、时间及技术约束寻找可追溯候选；不限 BOM。
清单匹配：将物料、能源、运输/处理服务等单项或批量需求匹配到过程数据集，保留行身份、依据、代理与未解决项，不修改原清单。
代表性复核：只读检查时间、地域、技术适用性、参考产品/单位、系统模型与证据质量，不把有效 ID 或相似度当成代表性结论。

plugins.recommended_prompt: 用 Querying LCA Datasets 为中国生产的 304 不锈钢寻找参考单位 kg 的过程数据集。先检查 CLI 与访问状态；列出来源、版本、模型、参考产品/单位、地域和可用时间/技术证据，说明代理及代表性缺口。有权限时读取真实 GWP，不估算，不修改模型或执行 EPD 审核。
plugins.recommended_prompt_en: Use Querying LCA Datasets to find process datasets for 304 stainless steel produced in China, with kg as reference unit. Check CLI access; report source/version/model, reference product/unit, geography and available temporal/technology evidence. Explain proxies and representativeness gaps; retrieve real GWP only if authorized, without estimating, model edits or EPD audit.
